messages:
Eli Navarro: Hi all 1 urgent 1 my newborn was transferred to a NICU at an out-of-network hospital while my partner and I are on parental leave. We only have digital insurance card on my partner's phone but their phone died. Hospital is asking for proof of coverage and wants a deposit. What can we show?
Priya Singh: Congrats Eli. First: we can generate a temporary proof-of-coverage letter and push a replacement digital card to your partner's email immediately. Second: ask the NICU to accept a carrier verification call if they refuse the TMP letter.
Eli Navarro: Deposit demand is 2k and they say they won't proceed without payment. I'm panicking.
Oncall Nurse: NICU note: medically necessary newborn care is typically covered. File an urgent coverage verification and ask provider billing to hold on deposit when carrier is contacted. If they still insist, ask for an itemized estimate and the hospital's billing contact; we'll push to carrier for direct payment authorization.
Benefits Bot: Generated temporary dependent coverage letter (ref TMP-NICU-004). Valid 14 days. Includes provisional policy number and authorization to contact carrier for verification. Download: https://internal.benefits.redwood/letters/TMP-NICU-004
Eli Navarro: Thank you 1 can you push the digital card to partner's email? Phone's dead and hospital won't accept screenshot.
Benefits Bot: Temporary digital card pushed to partner email (navarro.partner@redwood.com) and to Eli's HR email. Card includes QR and policy reference. Also attached TMP-NICU-004.
Eli Navarro: Hospital still asks for carrier phone verification. Can you get Mercury on the line now?
Carrier Rep - Mercury Health: Hi Eli 1 opened an urgent claim verification. Please provide hospital billing contact and itemized estimate. We'll attempt immediate authorization for medically necessary NICU stay pending formal claim. Reference code: URG-NICU-2198765432. Expect carrier callback within 2 hours.
Eli Navarro: Billing contact: billing@st-marys-icu.es, phone +34-91-555-0123. Itemized estimate uploaded to benefits portal.
Payroll Bot: FYI re premiums: provisional dependent coverage will be effective DOB for claims processing. Payroll will not post premium deductions until Benefits confirms final enrollment. If enrollment is finalized retro to DOB, payroll will apply pro-rated premium adjustments on next payroll run.
Priya Singh: I've escalated to Exec Benefits for override if carrier stalls. Also marking this as emergency medical assistance so Collections is instructed to pause any external collection while TMP-NICU-004 is active. Eli 1 DM me any hospital forms they want signed.
Eli Navarro: DM'd the consent form and estimate. Appreciate the fast help 1 will update once carrier calls. :pray:
